# Systemia Atlas Freight Load Exception Intelligence

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: systemia-atlas-freight
Class: freight_load_exception_and_document_intelligence
Canonical URL: https://base44.app/api/apps/69455b200bffe3a07c7bb042/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
Authority: public discovery of read-only freight exception intelligence within authorized organization scope
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- what is wrong with this load
- audit this freight load for exceptions
- check this carrier and load paperwork
- find missing POD or rate mismatches
- summarize freight risk on this shipment
- what recoverable charges or detention issues exist

## Boundaries
- no approved machine price or payment path is verified
- analysis does not authorize dispatch, quote acceptance, carrier contact, claim filing, payment or invoice action
- financial impact is reported only when supported by recorded evidence
- organization-scoped or private freight records remain access controlled

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
